hints.title: Review DNS roles
hints.detail: Confirm whether the detected DNS-capable hosts are expected to serve DNS, and inspect their forwarding or recursion configuration if they appear unusual.

hints.title: Validate directory expectations
hints.detail: If Active Directory services are expected on this site, confirm the selected subnet and check whether LDAP, Kerberos, or Global Catalog ports are being filtered or hosted elsewhere.

hints.title: Secure printer access
hints.detail: Disable raw printing (port 9100/JetDirect) on printers where it is not required, or restrict it to the print server IP only. Enable authentication on printer management interfaces and keep firmware up to date.
